name: SQL Server
summary: Azure SQL logical server hosting one or more single databases, Entra ID only authentication, private access only.
useWhen: You need a relational database with joins, transactions and a familiar T-SQL surface
You need a managed, PaaS single database rather than a full Managed Instance
avoidWhen: You need SQL Server instance-level features (SQL Agent, CLR, linked servers) or near-100% compatibility with an existing SQL Server (use SQL Managed Instance instead)
You need a non-relational, globally distributed store (use Cosmos DB)
